questions.text: According to the text "A Snapshot of WKU", where is Amir during the exam?
questions.hint: "a group of second-year Computer Science students is taking a programming exam" in Room 312.

questions.text: In the text, Kamila is a paid library employee.
questions.hint: "Kamila works as a volunteer library assistant" — volunteer means unpaid, by free choice.

questions.text: What are the two biology students near the fountain arguing about?
opts: Which café has the best coffee
questions.correct: Which café has the best coffee
questions.hint: "Two students near the fountain are arguing — not about biology, but about which café makes the best coffee in Uralsk."

questions.text: The text says that even late at night, students are lying in bed ___ at the ceiling.
questions.hint: "students are studying... lying in bed staring at the ceiling — thinking about the future."

questions.text: What does the final paragraph of the reading mainly suggest?
opts: University life goes on even after hours
questions.correct: University life goes on even after hours
questions.hint: "The university never really stops. Even late at night... students are studying..." — university is always active.

questions.text: "Life at WKU is always in motion" means:
opts: There is always something happening at WKU
WKU has a good transport system
questions.correct: There is always something happening at WKU
questions.hint: "in motion" = always moving, always active. Never stopping — always something happening.

questions.text: In the phone call, where is Rustam when he calls Kamila?
questions.hint: "I'm standing outside the canteen."

questions.text: Zhibek is sending Kamila a text message about the tournament.
questions.hint: "She's already sending you a VOICE MESSAGE about it." Not a text.

questions.text: Rustam says someone next to them is playing ___ loudly.
questions.hint: "Someone next to us is playing music — it's quite loud actually."

questions.text: What is Amir doing instead of joining his friends?
questions.hint: "Amir is still in the lab. He's fixing some code."

questions.text: What does Kamila order for dinner?
questions.hint: "Soup and bread, please."

questions.text: Kamila says she will ignore Zhibek's voice message until after eating.
questions.hint: "I'm ignoring it." + she says not to look at the tournament draw until after eating.

questions.text: "She ___ in the library right now." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: "right now" = Present Continuous. She → is studying.

questions.text: The -ing form of "run" is:
questions.hint: run: CVC → double n + ing: running.

questions.text: "___ you coming to dinner?" — "No, I ___ ."
questions.hint: "Are you...?" → Present Continuous question. Short answer: "No, I'm not."

questions.text: "I'm loving this song!" — What is wrong?
questions.hint: "love" is stative. ✅ "I love this song!" — never "I'm loving..."

questions.text: "She ___ every day, but today she ___ football." Choose the correct pair.
questions.hint: "every day" = PS habit. "today" = PC temporary/different. studies / is playing. ✅

questions.text: "Listen! Someone ___ music in the corridor."
questions.hint: "Listen!" = signal for right now → PC: "is playing."

questions.text: "What does she doing?" is a correctly formed Present Continuous question.
questions.hint: ✅ "What IS she DOING?" — use "is/am/are", NOT "does/do" for PC questions.

questions.text: "My English ___ this semester — I can feel it!" Choose correctly.
questions.hint: Changing/developing trend = PC: "My English is improving." Getting better over a period.

questions.text: "The campus is alive with activity." What does this mean?
opts: Many things are happening at once
questions.correct: Many things are happening at once
questions.hint: "alive with activity" = full of busy, energetic simultaneous activity.

questions.text: She is checking the ___ draw for next weekend's competition.
questions.hint: A "tournament draw" = the schedule/bracket for a competition (volleyball, football, etc.).

questions.text: "She is scrolling through her phone." What does "scroll through" mean?
opts: Move through content on a screen
questions.correct: Move through content on a screen
questions.hint: "scroll through" = move up or down through content on a phone/screen.

questions.text: "Kamila works as a volunteer library assistant." A volunteer:
opts: works by free choice without pay
questions.correct: works by free choice without pay
questions.hint: "volunteer" = a person who works freely and without payment.

questions.text: "The team is practising for a regional tournament." A tournament is:
questions.hint: "tournament" = a competition where many players or teams play a series of matches.
